<!-- Sentry React 10.x init shape (02-RESEARCH.md §1 L202-L233 + §2 L392-L432) -->
<!-- DO NOT adapt — kwargs validated against docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/react/ -->

```typescript
// frontend/src/lib/sentry.ts skeleton
import * as Sentry from '@sentry/react';

const AUTH_PATHS = ['/login', '/register', '/oauth-callback', '/reset-password', '/2fa'];

export function initSentry(): void {
  if (import.meta.env.MODE === 'development') return;
  const dsn = import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN;
  if (!dsn) return;

  Sentry.init({
    dsn,
    environment: import.meta.env.MODE,  // "staging" | "production"
    release: import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_RELEASE,
    sendDefaultPii: false,               // D-36; v10 strictly excludes IP (Landmine 11)
    tracesSampleRate: 0.05,              // D-38
    replaysSessionSampleRate: 0,         // D-32 — zero ambient replay
    replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0,       // D-32 — 100% on error
    integrations: [
      Sentry.browserTracingIntegration(),
      Sentry.replayIntegration({
        maskAllText: true,                      // D-36
        maskAllInputs: true,                    // D-36
        blockAllMedia: true,
        beforeErrorSampling: () => {            // D-37: drops replay on auth pages; event still reports
          const path = window.location.pathname;
          return !AUTH_PATHS.some((p) => path.startsWith(p));
        },
      }),
    ],
  });
}
```

<!-- ErrorBoundary componentDidCatch diff (D-35 — 3-line addition) -->

```typescript
// frontend/src/components/common/ErrorBoundary.tsx — import block gets one new line:
import * as Sentry from '@sentry/react';

// componentDidCatch body — current 1 line → 2 lines:
override componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
  console.error('ErrorBoundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo);
  Sentry.captureException(error, { extra: { componentStack: errorInfo.componentStack } });
}
```

<!-- vite.config.ts conditional plugin (D-34) -->

```typescript
// frontend/vite.config.ts
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react-swc';
import { sentryVitePlugin } from '@sentry/vite-plugin';
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

const isCIBuild = !!process.env.CI && !!process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN;

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [
    react(),
    tailwindcss(),
    ...(isCIBuild
      ? [sentryVitePlugin({
          org: process.env.SENTRY_ORG,
          project: process.env.SENTRY_PROJECT,
          authToken: process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN,
          release: { name: process.env.SENTRY_RELEASE },
        })]
      : []),
  ],
  build: { sourcemap: 'hidden' },  // D-34 / Landmine 12: required for plugin to have maps to upload
  // ... preserve existing server/test/resolve config ...
});
```

    ```typescript
    import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

    /**
     * OBS-05 init + config + beforeErrorSampling coverage for frontend Sentry.
     *
     * Decision refs: 02-CONTEXT.md D-32..D-43, D-51. Landmine refs: 02-RESEARCH.md

     * auth-route errors still report, replay just doesn't attach).

     * Must mock @sentry/react because it is an external npm package. vi.stubEnv
     * is the vitest idiom for import.meta.env.* overrides.
     */

    const mockedInit = vi.fn();
    const mockedBrowserTracing = vi.fn(() => ({ name: 'browserTracing' }));
    const mockedReplay = vi.fn((opts: unknown) => ({ name: 'replay', _opts: opts }));

    vi.mock('@sentry/react', () => ({
      init: mockedInit,
      browserTracingIntegration: mockedBrowserTracing,
      replayIntegration: mockedReplay,
      captureException: vi.fn(),
      setUser: vi.fn(),
    }));

    describe('initSentry — env gate', () => {
      beforeEach(() => {
        vi.clearAllMocks();
        vi.unstubAllEnvs();
      });

      it('no-ops when MODE is development', async () => {
        vi.stubEnv('MODE', 'development');
        vi.stubEnv('VITE_SENTRY_DSN', 'https://x@y/1');
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        expect(mockedInit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });

      it('no-ops when DSN is empty', async () => {
        vi.stubEnv('MODE', 'production');
        vi.stubEnv('VITE_SENTRY_DSN', '');
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        expect(mockedInit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });

      it('initializes in staging with DSN', async () => {
        vi.stubEnv('MODE', 'staging');
        vi.stubEnv('VITE_SENTRY_DSN', 'https://x@y/1');
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        expect(mockedInit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      });
    });

    describe('initSentry — config invariants', () => {
      beforeEach(() => {
        vi.clearAllMocks();
        vi.unstubAllEnvs();
        vi.stubEnv('MODE', 'production');
        vi.stubEnv('VITE_SENTRY_DSN', 'https://x@y/1');
      });

      it('sets sendDefaultPii false, replay sample rates, traces sample rate', async () => {
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        const cfg = mockedInit.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>;
        expect(cfg.sendDefaultPii).toBe(false);
        expect(cfg.replaysSessionSampleRate).toBe(0);
        expect(cfg.replaysOnErrorSampleRate).toBe(1.0);
        expect(cfg.tracesSampleRate).toBe(0.05);
      });

      it('passes environment = MODE', async () => {
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        const cfg = mockedInit.mock.calls[0][0] as Record<string, unknown>;
        expect(cfg.environment).toBe('production');
      });
    });

    describe('beforeErrorSampling auth-route gate', () => {
      beforeEach(() => {
        vi.clearAllMocks();
        vi.unstubAllEnvs();
        vi.stubEnv('MODE', 'production');
        vi.stubEnv('VITE_SENTRY_DSN', 'https://x@y/1');
      });

      async function extractHook(): Promise<(...a: unknown[]) => boolean> {
        const { initSentry } = await import('./sentry');
        initSentry();
        const replayCall = mockedReplay.mock.calls[0][0] as { beforeErrorSampling: (...a: unknown[]) => boolean };
        return replayCall.beforeErrorSampling;
      }

      function setPath(p: string) {
        Object.defineProperty(window, 'location', {
          configurable: true,
          value: { ...window.location, pathname: p },
        });
      }

      it.each(['/login', '/register', '/oauth-callback', '/reset-password', '/2fa'])(
        'drops replay on auth path %s',
        async (path: string) => {
          const hook = await extractHook();
          setPath(path);
          expect(hook()).toBe(false);
        },
      );

      it.each(['/login/extra', '/register/foo', '/oauth-callback?code=abc'])(
        'drops replay on auth-path prefix match %s',
        async (path: string) => {
          const hook = await extractHook();
          setPath(path);
          expect(hook()).toBe(false);
        },
      );

      it.each(['/dashboard', '/cars', '/', '/build-lists/42'])(
        'attaches replay on non-auth path %s',
        async (path: string) => {
          const hook = await extractHook();
          setPath(path);
          expect(hook()).toBe(true);
        },
      );
    });
    ```

    ```typescript
    import '@testing-library/jest-dom';
    import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
    import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
    import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

    /**
     * OBS-05 ErrorBoundary → Sentry.captureException assertion (D-35).
     *
     * The existing styled fallback UI MUST still render (D-35: "Keep the existing
     * class component + styled fallback UI. 3-line change. No Sentry.ErrorBoundary
     * HOC swap.") — this test co-asserts the captureException call AND the
     * fallback render to pin that invariant.
     */

    const mockedCapture = vi.fn();
    vi.mock('@sentry/react', () => ({
      captureException: mockedCapture,
    }));

    import ErrorBoundary from './ErrorBoundary';

    function Thrower(): ReactNode {
      throw new Error('boom');
    }

    function Safe(): ReactNode {
      return <div>all good</div>;
    }

    describe('ErrorBoundary', () => {
      it('renders children when no error thrown', () => {
        mockedCapture.mockClear();
        render(
          <ErrorBoundary>
            <Safe />
          </ErrorBoundary>,
        );
        expect(screen.getByText('all good')).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(mockedCapture).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });

      it('renders fallback UI and reports to Sentry when child throws', () => {
        mockedCapture.mockClear();
        render(
          <ErrorBoundary>
            <Thrower />
          </ErrorBoundary>,
        );
        expect(mockedCapture).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        const [errorArg, extraArg] = mockedCapture.mock.calls[0];
        expect(errorArg).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
        expect((errorArg as Error).message).toBe('boom');
        expect(extraArg).toMatchObject({
          extra: { componentStack: expect.any(String) },
        });
      });
    });
    ```

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Browser error → Sentry SaaS | DSN is public-safe (Vite pattern, D-33); traffic leaves the user's browser to sentry.io |
| Auth page URL fragments → Session Replay | `beforeErrorSampling` gate blocks replay attachment on token-bearing routes |
| CI build artifact → Sentry sourcemap endpoint | SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN gates plugin activation; local builds never upload |
| User identity → Sentry event | `Sentry.setUser` accepts ONLY `{id: string}`; no email/username/name |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan / Acceptance |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|------------------------------|
| T-02-PII-SENTRY | Information Disclosure | Sentry event user field + AuthContext | high | mitigate | D-36 + D-40: `sendDefaultPii: false` in init config; `Sentry.setUser({id: String(user.id)})` passes ONLY id. Matches backend D-09 PII posture. Session Replay masks ALL text + inputs (`maskAllText: true`, `maskAllInputs: true`). Acceptance: `grep -n "sendDefaultPii: false" frontend/src/lib/sentry.ts` returns 1; `grep -n "{ id: String(user.id) }" frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` returns 1; no `email` or `username` passed to Sentry.setUser (code inspection during review). Test `config invariants` pins `sendDefaultPii === false`. v10 strict IP exclusion (Landmine 11) also active when sendDefaultPii=false. |
| T-02-REPLAY-TOKENS | Information Disclosure | Session Replay capture on auth routes | high | mitigate | D-37: `beforeErrorSampling` hook returns `false` for `/login`, `/register`, `/oauth-callback`, `/reset-password`, `/2fa` pathname prefixes. Errors on those pages STILL report to Sentry (Landmine 14 — replay attach is a separate decision from error report). Acceptance: 15+ parametrized tests in `sentry.test.ts` cover all 5 auth paths + 3 prefix-match patterns + 4 non-auth paths. |
| T-02-TEST-POLLUTION | Tampering | `initSentry` firing during vitest runs | medium | mitigate | Two gates: `MODE === 'development'` → return; empty DSN → return. vitest sets `MODE=test` by default which is NOT `development`, BUT `VITE_SENTRY_DSN` is unset in test env → no-op path taken. Acceptance: `no-ops when DSN is empty` test passes; no stray Sentry events during `npm test -- --run`. |
| T-02-SOURCEMAP-LEAK | Information Disclosure | Bundled .map files | medium | mitigate | `build.sourcemap: 'hidden'` emits `.map` files for plugin upload but DOES NOT include `//# sourceMappingURL=...` comments in the bundle — end users can't discover + fetch the maps from the CDN (Landmine 12). Acceptance: `grep -n "sourcemap:" frontend/vite.config.ts` returns 1 match with value `'hidden'` or `true`; post-build inspection: `grep -r "sourceMappingURL" frontend/dist/ \| grep -v '.map:'` returns 0 comment occurrences in `.js` files (only inside `.map` files). |
| T-02-FREE-TIER | Denial of Service (cost) | Sentry free-tier quota 500 replays/mo | low | mitigate | D-32 `replaysSessionSampleRate=0` means ambient replay = 0; `replaysOnErrorSampleRate=1.0` means replay count ≤ error count. At a 5K error budget, replay stays well under 500. Belt-and-suspenders: operator enables Sentry-internal spend cap per Landmine 18. |
</threat_model>
